post_title: What value will the Crypto Fear & Greed Index record for November 27, 2026?

question.title: What value will the Crypto Fear & Greed Index record for November 27, 2026?
question.description:
Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index (often called the Bitcoin Fear & Greed Index) is a 0–100 daily sentiment gauge for the crypto market that has been published continuously since 1 February 2018. It aggregates six components — volatility (25%), market momentum/volume (25%), social media (15%), surveys (15%), bitcoin dominance (10%) and search trends (10%) — into a single integer reading that is updated once per day, with the full history available free through the site's API. The index has printed 5 as its all-time low (22 August 2019, repeated on 12 and 23 February 2026) and 95 as its all-time high. Over the past twelve months it ranged from 5 (February 2026, when bitcoin traded near $60,000) to 78 (22 September 2026). Readings below 25 are labelled "Extreme Fear".

Status quo as of 13 November 2026: the index reads 20 ("Extreme Fear"), down from 28 the day before, 28 a week earlier and 62 a month earlier — its lowest level in more than four months, after spending most of early October in the high 60s and low 70s ("Greed"). The drop coincides with a sharp market sell-off: bitcoin fell below $70,000 in Asian trading hours on 13 November, touching roughly $68,900 — its lowest level since 19 August and about 13% below its 5 November close — while ether traded below $2,000 (around $1,947) and crypto futures saw roughly $1.2–1.3 billion of liquidations in 24 hours, including about $677 million in bitcoin positions, according to Coinglass. US spot bitcoin ETFs have now seen net outflows for well over a week and are negative by more than $1.5 billion year-to-date, with more than $500 million of redemptions during the week. Macro conditions have added pressure: a hot October inflation print lifted market-implied odds of a Federal Reserve rate increase to around 90%, and the dollar index hit a 19-month high.

Sentiment gauges of this kind can move quickly in both directions. In August 2026 the index jumped from 36 ("Fear") to 81 ("Extreme Greed") within a week, its fastest swing of the year, and in February–March 2026 it sat in the single digits to low teens for extended stretches during the drawdown to $60,000. A two-week window is therefore wide enough for the reading on 27 November 2026 to be materially below the current 20 (if liquidations and ETF outflows continue) or comfortably back in "Fear" or "Neutral" territory (if bitcoin stabilises or rebounds).

Note that several third-party sites republish or re-derive "crypto fear and greed" numbers, and their readings for the same day can differ from Alternative.me's by several points (recent prints of 20, 21 and 28 have circulated for 12–13 November 2026 across aggregators). This question pins resolution exclusively to Alternative.me's own published daily series, which is the original and most widely cited version of the index.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the value that Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index records for 2026-11-27 in its daily history. The definitive figure is the API entry with the timestamp for November 27, 2026 (00:00 UTC), returned by https://api.alternative.me/fng/ and also listed as that date's reading at https://alternative.me/crypto/fear-and-greed-index/; if the two ever differ, the API entry governs. For example, if that daily reading is 31 the question resolves to 31; if it is 17 the question resolves to 17.
question.fine_print: The index publishes one integer reading per day; the classification label Alternative.me attaches to that reading (e.g. "Fear" or "Extreme Fear") plays no role in resolution, and neither do readings from other publishers of fear-and-greed indices, whose numbers can differ by several points. If Alternative.me has permanently discontinued the index by the resolution date, the question is annulled. A temporary site or API outage, or a delayed daily update, does not annul it: resolution waits until the 2026-11-27 entry is published.
